newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil up at close on late shortcovering.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil up at close on late shortcovering.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES- The market moved up towards the close on active shortcovering and speculative buying. The rise reflected a technical adjustment to recent losses. More covering and demand came when May futures contract was unable to fall below the 1,250 ringgit. Next resistance for May is 1,285.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL -Cash products attracted some buying at current low levels and interest was seen among RBD palm olein.
At the close, the May futures contract rose 20 ringgit to 1,276 ringgit ($513.89) a tonne after falling to a 1,252 low.
"Uncertainty was seen in the morning market," a trader said, adding that players were unsure about the fundamental outlook in the short-term.
Some traders said the market is expecting larger output in coming months and slow demand from consumers. "This is affecting the sentiment only," a trader said.
Ivan Wong, a private forecaster said that production in February was projected to fall 21 percent over January, while some trades estimated falls of up to 20 to 23 percent.
"The market may be covering ahead of February exports data on Friday," another trader said.

Physical Mar (south) crude palm oil was offered 1,322.50 ringgit against bids of 1,317.50 with earlier trades done at 1,305, 1,310 and 1,317.50. Mar (central) saw offers at 1,315 and bids at 1,310 and Mar (north) at 1,310 against bids 1,300.
Apr (south) was offered at 1,315 with bids at 1,307.50 after trading at 1,290 and 1,305. Apr (central) saw offers at 1,310 with bids at 1,300.
Among refined products, Mar RBD palm oil was offered at $562.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Apr at $557.50 and May/Jun at $550.
Mar RBD palm olein saw offers at $592.50, Apr at $582.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $577.50. Mar was dealt at $587.50, $586,$585 and Apr at $577.50 and $580.
Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $467.50 and Mar/Apr palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $307.50.
